newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shiseido to build second French factory.
newsitem.headline: Shiseido to build second French factory.

text.p: Shiseido Co Ltd said on Monday that it would build its second factory in France in the city of Ormes and expects the plant to be operational in January 1999.
The total cost of the new plant is expected to be at about 3.5 billion yen, including land and building costs, the Japanese cosmetics maker said in a statement.
The factory will be Shiseido's second in Europe and in France. It already has a factory in Gien, France.
The plant will be its 10th factory abroad.
Shiseido said it was strengthening its business in Europe and felt a need for a stronger production capability to meet anticipated demand increases in Europe towards 2000.
The new French factory will produce skincare products, makeup and fragrances, Shiseido said.
After developing its distribution capability, the new factory will also ship Shiseido products made in the United States and Asia to Europe, the company said.

Once the new factory is operational, the Gien factory, which now produces fragrances and bodycare products, will become a specialised fragrance production facility and supervise operations of both factories, Shiseido said.
